rationale: v1.80.1 had temporary Zigbee topology but no durable Z2M cache. This adds successful-map survival across HA/integration restarts, with explicit refresh/OFF deletion and visible storage failures; it is a new user capability rather than polishing an intermediate-only feature.

summary.ru: Связи Zigbee2MQTT сохраняются после перезапуска HA; устаревшая карта остаётся доступной до обновления или выключения связей.
summary.en: Zigbee2MQTT maps survive HA restarts and remain available as stale data until refreshed or links are disabled.
